Reach Ward.name: Reach Ward
Reach Ward.description: The user holds the weapon point-first between the user and the opponent and snaps a strike at anyone who steps inside its reach. An opponent who tries to close to fist or grappling range this turn is struck first, taking bludgeoning damage from a blunt weapon or slashing or piercing damage from a blade, and is stopped at weapon length. Stamina: brief.
